objective: Turn Alpha→Omega into a commercially viable service-enabled platform before promoting self-service SaaS
execution_rule: Execute and promote stages in dependency order. Technical reference-provider proof may advance implementation, but market, payment, cloud, customer and legal claims require fresh external evidence.

external_evidence_admission.admission_rule: Only fresh external provider-native evidence satisfying gate-specific claims, provider authority and owner-reserved confirmation may advance an external maturity gate.

stages.name: Commercial Product Definition
stages.maturity_gate: offer catalogue, ICP, pricing and sales assets pass deterministic contract tests; external demand remains unproven

stages.name: Tenant and Identity Foundation
stages.maturity_gate: tenant isolation, RBAC, hash-chained audit and data-boundary tests

stages.name: Secrets and Provider Authority
stages.maturity_gate: six reversible provider operations have fresh execution, readback, persistence and rollback proof; Cloud Run remains blocked at WIF token exchange; secret, payment and owner-reserved authority remain held

stages.name: Customer Onboarding and Workspace Provisioning
stages.maturity_gate: idempotent local reference workspace creation, receipt, rollback and restore verified; live customer provider required

stages.name: Billing, Metering and Cost Governance
stages.maturity_gate: usage ledger, plan enforcement, invoice-ready export and budget controls verified; no invoice or payment claim

stages.name: Managed Operations and SLA Fabric
stages.maturity_gate: reversible GitHub, Drive, Gmail-draft, Calendar, Outlook-draft and Canva operations are verified with readback and rollback; production Cloud Run health and SLA proof remains blocked

stages.name: Provider Adapter Expansion
stages.maturity_gate: six provider-native reversible adapters pass execution, exact readback, persistence and rollback; Cloud Run and additional consequential providers remain open

stages.name: Solution Catalogue and Capability Marketplace
stages.maturity_gate: immutable releases, lineage, tenant entitlement and licensing controls verified; no marketplace sale claimed

stages.name: Partner and White-Label Programme
stages.maturity_gate: partner tenant, branding, draft licence and revenue-share calculation verified; partner contract and adoption required

stages.name: Security, Privacy and Enterprise Assurance
stages.maturity_gate: evidence-bound access, audit, privacy, retention and recovery controls; completed privacy workflow; integrity and RTO-passing DR drill; external attestation remains open

stages.name: Customer Portal and Self-Service SaaS
stages.maturity_gate: service-enabled reversible provider operations are verified; Gmail/Outlook send, Canva commit, subscriptions, payments, Cloud Run and consequential self-service actions remain held

stages.name: Case Studies and Commercial Proof
stages.maturity_gate: baseline, outcome, provenance, publication and external-evidence admission gates are operational; internal, synthetic or mock evidence cannot establish customer outcomes

stages.name: Sales and Revenue Operations
stages.maturity_gate: lead funnel, qualification, draft quotation, owner approval, draft contract and payment-receipt admission controls are operational; verified revenue remains zero

stages.name: Scale, Reliability and Unit Economics
stages.maturity_gate: reference reliability and reversible-provider rollback gates pass; fresh Cloud Run and production-scale latency, recovery and economics evidence remain required

stages.name: Commercial Maturity and Succession
stages.maturity_gate: canonical receipts, external-evidence admission, provider freshness, six reversible provider operations, exact Cloud Run WIF block, restart readback and rollback are verified; full maturity requires every external gate

provider_authority_acquisition.admission_rule: Alternate-provider conformance may verify contracts and packaging but cannot grant provider authority. Live authority requires fresh provider-native evidence, exact scope, required proof gates and owner confirmation where reserved.
